verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents embedded expense policies, spend limits, real-time purchase review, and automated emails when receipts or memos are missing. None of this is described as AI that automatically flags anomalous or out-of-policy transactions for review. These are adjacent controls and manual review features, so they earn no credit toward the story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI flag anomalous or out-of-policy transactions automatically for review
